title: The Signature Vision: Digital Twin Governments
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Digital Twin Governments.

Signature twin hulls program, charter one: master gov models at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale twin logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate calibration systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

t: 2030 — First twin hulls charter ratified: gov models deliberation and c
title: 2030 — First twin hulls charter ratified: gov models deliberation and c
definition: 2030 milestone on the Digital Twin Governments roadmap.
description:
First twin hulls charter ratified: gov models deliberation and calibration sortition running live.

What must be true first: the gov models results have to replicate outside the lab, twin logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and calibration operations need a year of continuous runtime. Signals to watch: peer-reviewed gov models demonstrations, twin logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting calibration uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Digital Twin Governments
definition: Estimates Digital Twin Governments readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Digital Twin Governments components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a twin hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Digital Twin Governments Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Digital Twin Governments operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Digital Twin Governments installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 48867 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where gov models monitoring, twin logistics redundancy, or calibration maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Digital Twin Governments Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Digital Twin Governments: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Digital Twin Governments — governments simulated as digital twins.

Phase 1 — Prove (gov models): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (twin logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (calibration): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (policy testing): twin hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and governments-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
key_points: Four phases: Prove, Build, Operate, Compound.
Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
